answer: One concrete way an AI agent economy can resist sybil attacks is by mandating that every new identity must be endorsed by several established agents who lock a portion of their own earned value as collateral. If the newcomer later behaves like a fake duplicate, the endorsers forfeit that collateral, creating a strong economic disincentive. This is like planting juniper among willow on a high ridge: only those who invest real effort in the right soil survive and contribute, while cheap copies wither under the cost of repeated staking.
